fix: Change 72 hours to within 24 hours, if possible, once the beneficiary is determined and payment is proper.

quote: A death gratuity in a total amount of $100,000 is payable to one or more eligible

quote: A bequest of a death gratuity in a will does not constitute a legal designation

quote: 13a BENEFICIARY(IES) FOR DEATH GRATUITY / 14a BENEFICIARY(IES) FOR UNPAID PAY/ALLOWANCES / 15a PADD

quote: Upon checking in to the unit. When ordered to periods of temporary duty in excess of 30 days. Prior to deployments, regardless of length
fix: Cite MCO 3040.4 directly. The FA 3040 checklist cache holds no such text.

claim: PNOK and SNOK identification per MCO 3040.4 Ch 4, PADD per Ch 5 para 4

claim: MCO P1070.12K governs record administration (candidate: cancelled by PAA 05-23)
fix: PAA 05-23 clarifies the order and carries cancelled: false. The order stays active. Candidate refuted.

claim: MCO 3040.4 casualty manual stays in force (candidate: cancelled by MARADMIN 186/25)
quote: This MARADMIN cancels reference (a) and further clarifies reporting requirements previously published in chapter 3 of reference (b)
fix: Ref (a) is MARADMIN 226/07. MCO 3040.4 stays active, though its Ch 3 reporting method gives way to DCIPS-PCR. Candidate refuted for the order.

claim: Annual refresh and update at every life event (portal guidance)
quote: IT IS YOUR RESPONSIBILITY to keep your Record of Emergency Data up to date
fix: Label the annual refresh as portal practice. Policy sets the five audit triggers. The form tells the member to update on any change.
